verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents in-app history rewriting from the commit list: long-tap a commit to Delete Commit, Edit Message, or Squash a commit with its child. Undo of unpushed commits and Amend of the latest commit add further rewriting. Reordering commits is never documented, and 'edit' covers only commit messages, not commit contents mid-history. missing for 10: commit reordering, editing the contents of past commits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can interactively rewrite history by deleting, editing, squashing, or reordering commits

citations.quote: Long tapping commits you can Delete Commit to rewrite the branch without the work contributed by this single commit, Edit Message to change a commit message... or Squash a commit with its child.
For commits not yet pushed to a remote, swipe left to Undo them.
To make changes to the latest commit enable Amend at the top of the commit dialog.
